red_lines.treasury_selling: disclosed (OpenGov Refs 457/1104/1501/1729 swap treasury DOT for USDT/USDC through Hydration DCA; Ref 1729 = 2.64M DOT)
red_lines.chain_stalls_2026: 4 partial stalls (parachains 23 Mar, People chain 22 Apr, Asset Hub ~30 min 12 Jun, staking election 30 Jun - 3 Jul); no funds lost

front_matter_extras.revenue_mechanism: Fees are tiny and none is paid to holders; staking rewards come from issuance.

But nothing found suggests real usage fees large enough to matter against a $1.25B market cap, and none of it is paid to holders: it sits in a protocol pool that governance spends. Stakers are paid with new DOT. **2, which trips the Revenue gate.**
